Diese historische Residenz in Kumasi dient als traditioneller Sitz des Asantehene, des Königs des Ashanti-Reiches.
Ez a kumasi történelmi rezidencia az Ashanti Birodalom királyának, az Asantehene-nek a hagyományos székhelye.
Această reședință istorică din Kumasi servește drept sediul tradițional al Asantehene, regele Imperiului Ashanti.
This historic residence in Kumasi serves as the traditional seat of the Asantehene, the king of the Ashanti Empire.
